feature: moving-average cost basis + realized P/L engine (tax-engine)

commands.summary: 1 test file; 11 tests passed (incl. gen-2 hardening: NaN/Infinity guard, log_index tie-break).

boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: computes realized P/L and ratio for a single acquire + dispose

boundaryCases.scenario: two acquisitions at different prices then disposal
boundaryCases.expected: moving average cost basis and zero P/L at the average price

boundaryCases.scenario: IN with null fiat_value / UNKNOWN price
boundaryCases.expected: excluded, does not seed average; later sell sees zero holdings, null ratio, and review flag
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: excludes events with a null fiat_value / UNKNOWN price and never mutates holdings

boundaryCases.expected: cost capped at holdings, excess zero-cost, review=disposal_exceeds_holdings
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: caps recognized cost at holdings and flags over-disposal

boundaryCases.expected: all excluded and no holdings mutation
negative realized P/L and negative ratio
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: reports losses with a negative P/L and negative ratio

boundaryCases.expected: realized P/L is retained but pnlRatio is null rather than infinity or a fabricated value
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: returns a null P/L ratio when the recognized cost basis is zero

boundaryCases.scenario: same events supplied in forward and reverse array order
boundaryCases.expected: identical disposal result after occurredAt ordering
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: is independent of input array order (folds by occurredAt)

boundaryCases.expected: separate running averages per asset key
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: keeps separate averages per asset key

boundaryCases.expected: excluded, never poisons the running average (gen-2)
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: excludes NaN/Infinity fiat and quantity instead of poisoning the average

boundaryCases.expected: folds by on-chain log_index so the sell has a real cost basis (gen-2)
boundaryCases.testRef: packages/tax-engine/src/core/cost-basis.spec.ts :: breaks same-timestamp ties by on-chain log_index

notes: Cost basis is computed read-time only. Monetary fields are decimal strings. Excluded events surface as excluded:true with excludeReason and never mutate holdings.
